checks.detail: All fourteen JSON files required by the source-backed pack contract are listed in manifest.fileInventory.
Every pack file is required to parse as strict JSON in the automated test.
Every claim sourceId resolves to sources.json and every manifest source resolves to the same canonical source registry.
The official announcement knownAt is 2026-06-27T00:00:00Z, derived from 20:00 America/New_York on June 26.
Every official claim exposed to the simulation has knownAt less than or equal to 2026-07-07T13:30:00Z.
The Reuters/JPMorgan estimate remains source metadata for post-event validation only and is not a simulation claim or calibration input.
Every model assumption and market condition is marked synthetic; official facts are marked non-synthetic and cite T1 sources.
market.json and benchmark.json both declare SYNTHETIC mode, false historical status, and false observed status.
The default paired experiment changes only marketMakerCapacity from 1.0 to 0.65.
IPO shares sold are retained as an offering fact and are not converted into free float or tradable supply.
FTSE global entry, Russell U.S. entry, and the $25 billion notes offering are explicitly represented as confounding events.
External sources use link-only metadata and short paraphrases; no copyrighted article, index series, or licensed market-data snapshot is bundled.
The pack disallows historical causal attribution, price forecasting, and investment use.

manualReviewRequired: A user must approve, edit, or reject every AI_PROPOSED synthetic assumption before freezing the pack.
Any future replacement of synthetic paths with observed data requires license review and point-in-time timestamp validation.
Any LLM cognition implementation must filter claims by knownAt on every simulation step.
